description: This file contains JavaScript code for Goteo Analytics, including functions for date calculations, funding data processing, and chart initialization for a crowdfunding project dashboard.

methods.name: GOTEO.getDates
methods.description: Calculates project deadlines, start date, and days left based on project status and dates.

methods.name: GOTEO.getFundingByDay
methods.description: Aggregates funding amounts and funder counts per day from investment data.

methods.name: GOTEO.initializeGraph
methods.description: Creates and initializes funding and funder charts with processed data.
